newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian finance ministry approves VSM new issue.
newsitem.headline: Russian finance ministry approves VSM new issue.

text.p: Russia's finance ministry approved a new 240 billion rouble issue of one-year government-backed bonds of rail firm RAO Vysokoskorostnye Magistrali (VSM) to be issued on October 3, a company official said on Friday.
"Everything is OK," Andrei Nikandrov, deputy finance director told Reuters. "Today we have passed the papers to the central bank."
The central bank is a general placement and payment agent for the issue.
The Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX), where auctions and trading in the paper take place, approved the issue on Wednesday, he said.
State-owned VSM (High-Speed Railways) is building a high-speed Moscow-St Petersburg rail link.
VSM issued 120 billion worth of bonds at the beginning of the year.
The securities are effectively the same as Russian OFZ interest-bearing government bonds. OFZ bonds pay quarterly interest linked to current issues of GKO discount Treasury bills.
